notes: Ek chhoti si theek-shuda update: pichli update mein phone app mein purani screen reh gayi thi, is liye TikTok ka option nazar nahi aya — is update mein wo theek kar diya hai; ab watch add karte waqt upar YouTube/TikTok chunne ka option ayega.
